dimensions.description: Runs end-to-end MCP initialize, tool list, and tool call roundtrip checks
An MCP tool call is valid iff the tool name is recognized and the board identifier is non-empty
An MCP protocol roundtrip is valid iff initialize, tool list, and tool call all succeed

lattice_artifacts.text: The McpJsonRpcRequest schema scoped to mcp_server has fields jsonrpc, id, method, and params in lattice/mcp_server.py and represents a JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP request envelope.

lattice_artifacts.name: verified_status_files_exist_law
lattice_artifacts.spec: verified_status_files_exist_law: MOD.can_transition_to_verified(is_verified, files_exist, within_max_lines) == Bool.or(Bool.not(is_verified), Bool.and(files_exist, within_max_lines))
lattice_artifacts.text: The mcp_server component must verify that verified_status_files_exist_law applies to groves at stage bend_exec_23c with parameters is_verified: Bool, files_exist: Bool, within_max_lines: Bool, such that MOD.can_transition_to_verified(is_verified, files_exist, within_max_lines) returns Bool.or(Bool.not(is_verified), Bool.and(files_exist, within_max_lines)) per Spec 28.
